card.name: Inside drug names before -ine/-ina
card.fires_on: A middle piece of a long drug name, just before the ending -INE or -INA, mostly in capitals (e.g. AZ in PROMETHAZINE, AD in TEPADINA, AM in DEXTROAMPHETAMINE).

modes.label: Capitalized drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of an all-caps drug name in label headings or warnings, right before INE/INA.
modes.example: ASSOCIATED WITH PROMETH<<AZ>>INE PRODUCTS AND ARE NOT DIRECTLY RELATED

modes.label: Lowercase drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of a lowercase or mixed-case drug or product name before -ine or -ene.

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing the drug name with an ending piece such as -ine, not toward the n-starting pieces it suppresses.
card.plain: It fires inside a long drug name, one step before the ending -ine or -ina.
